docs.title: markeitech.system.historical_probe.CurrentStateHistoricalDemandProbeActor
docs.text:
Bases: DataActor

Exercise current-state delivery before one real historical dependency request.

This actor is an explicitly enabled acceptance harness. It owns no calendar, provider, acquisition, or persistence behavior: it synchronizes through the production session-state protocol and publishes one normal symbolic demand only after reconciliation reaches LIVE.

Responsibilities
  • Gate one acceptance-only historical demand on reconciled current session state.
  • Observe the correlated plan, readiness, and transient historical batches.
  • Exercise one bounded snapshot retry when explicitly configured.

The command hierarchy owns parsing and fixed child-process mappings only. No command provisions dependencies, starts Docker, supplies the Interactive Brokers confirmation, or broadens connected or persistence authority.

Returns:

docs.title: markeitech.intelligence.CompletedBarInputIdentity dataclass
docs.text:
Identify one exact upstream path contributing to a canonical bar.

Canonical series identity is intentionally independent of the provider path which supplied an observation. Historical one-minute and live five-second inputs therefore converge into one output series while each lineage entry preserves its exact provider, adapter, stream, raw selector, and source schema identity.

Attributes:

  • provider_id (str) –

    Bounded provider identity, such as IB.

  • adapter_id (str) –

    Bounded adapter implementation identity.

  • source_stream_id (str) –

    Exact upstream stream or request-lane identity.

  • source_selector (str) –

    Exact raw input selector or native bar type.

  • source_schema_id (str) –

    Exact schema identity of the upstream observation.

Raises:

  • ValueError –

    If an identity is empty, non-ASCII, or exceeds its bound.
